lines: Delight, called own-nature-gain, through body-gate of selves bestows at night; which by that mudrā in śāstras described.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mudaṃ svarūpalābhākhyaṃ dehadvāreṇa cātmanām rātyarpayati yattena mudrā śāstreṣu varṇitā
